definitions.explanation: A walking aid that fits under the arm, used to keep weight off an injured leg.

examples.japanese: {松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく。
⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I broke my leg and am walking on crutches.

examples.japanese: {松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}ほど⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear it will be about a month before I can do without crutches.

notes:
Named for its forked shape, like a pine needle ({松葉|まつば}), + ⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧ (cane), voiced as づえ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく: to use crutches
- {松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk on crutches
- {松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: to get off crutches
- {松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: life on crutches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧: walking stick, cane — held in the hand, not under the arm
